tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (14.0:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-soft-purple
tokens.usage: AI intelligence, innovation, forward-thinking. Used as text on `.btn-secondary`, `.footer-link:hover`. 4.1:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-deep-purple
tokens.usage: Premium AI features, advanced capabilities. Used as text on `.page-title`, `.stat-value`, `.section-title`. 6.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Clarity, simplicity, conversational ease. Used as text on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.ai-search`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-off-white
tokens.usage: Subtle backgrounds, reduced cognitive load. Used as background on `body`, `.data-table tbody tr:hover`.

tokens.name: color-medium-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-title`, `.stat-insight`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-dark-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.data-table th`, `.form-label`, `.btn-tertiary`. 9.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gradient-end
tokens.usage: AI magic moments, smart features. Used as background on `.ai-suggestion`, `.badge-ai`.
